name: Solvexa
tagline: Solar Installer Toolkit — Measure • Calculate • Install • Succeed
description: Solvexa is a tool-first, offline-first Android field toolkit for solar installers and electricians by MTP Code / Manoranjan. No account, no login, no customer form — open the app, tap a tool, use it, done. A colorful tool-launcher dashboard puts a GPS Camera with a live coordinates/altitude/accuracy/heading overlay, a two-tone Compass with AR camera-background mode, an Angle Meter with solar-tilt guidance, a Level (Bubble/Flat-Surface/Corner), and around 20 electrical and solar calculators one tap away, alongside a Guides & Formulas reference. Hindi and English supported, light/dark theme, fully offline for all core functionality. Package ID: in.mtpcode.solvexa. Support: admin@mtpcode.com.
features: Tool-first dashboard: no account, no login, no customer form — tap a tool and use it immediately
Colorful tool-launcher home organized into Field Tools, Electrical Tools, Solar Tools, and Reference sections
GPS Camera with a live on-screen overlay (coordinates, altitude, accuracy, heading), opportunistic map snippet + place name when online, and an always-kept pristine original with optional watermark
Compass with a two-tone needle, an AR camera-background mode, and calibration
Angle Meter with protractor plus digital/gauge styles and solar tilt-recommendation guidance
Level with Bubble, Flat-Surface, and Corner modes

Around 20 electrical and solar calculators — Ohm's law, wire/voltage-drop, battery backup, inverter sizing, three-phase power, PFC capacitor sizing, conduit fill, breaker/fuse sizing, motor FLC, solar system sizing, sun position, tilt & orientation, energy estimator, and more
Hand-rolled result charts on the calculators where a visual makes the numbers clearer
Guides & Formulas plus a Tools & Equipment reference section
Hindi and English language support, light/dark theme
An optional, lightweight project/report feature exists in the app but isn't part of the main navigation — Solvexa is deliberately not a project-management tool
Offline-first: every core tool works with zero network access, with one narrow, disclosed exception for GPS Camera's opportunistic map tile and place-name lookup
Advisory-only calculators with clear disclaimers — not a substitute for qualified engineering judgment

notes: Public product page and Play-ready privacy/terms URLs
Tool-launcher dashboard, GPS Camera, Compass, Angle Meter, Level, ~20 electrical/solar calculators, Guides & Formulas, Hindi + English support
